title: Sale Cancellation Credit Amount — Monthly-Billed Rental Property Service Contracts
content:
**Credit definition.** The credit a landlord receives on confirming the cancellation of a monthly-billed Rental Property Service Contracts contract because the property was sold is posted as one cancellation credit for the cancellation request; the confirmation cancels the contract effective on the notice date.

The sale cancellation credit is the installment billed for the billing period in which notice was given times the unused share of that period, rounded to the cent once at the end, where the unused share is the calendar days after the notice date through the period's last day, divided by the period's days counted from its first day through its last day inclusive.

## Records

| Quantity | Read from |
|---|---|
| Notice date | the cancellation request |
| The installment, the period's first and last day | the monthly installment charge for the billing period in which the notice date falls |

## Worked examples (hypothetical contracts)

| Installment | Billing period | Notice date | Unused days | Period days | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| $61.74 | 15 April to 14 May | 4 May | 10 (5 to 14 May) | 30 | $61.74 times 10 divided by 30: **$20.58** |
| $45.59 | 1 July to 31 July | 10 July | 21 | 31 | $45.59 times 21 divided by 31 is $30.88355: **$30.88** |
| $142.47 | 15 April to 14 May | 14 May | 0 | 30 | **$0.00** |
